articles.title: Ken Griffin: Citadel expanding in Miami in response to NYC mayor Mamdani's 'poor taste' tax video
articles.description: Mamdani's office said in response to Griffin, "our tax system is fundamentally broken. It rewards extreme wealth while working people are pushed to the brink."

articles.title: Who is Zack Polanski, UK Greens leader and rising political star?
articles.description: Polanski has been likened to New York's Zohran Mamdani for his popular blend of environmental and socialist policies.

articles.title: AMD's Su explains what's behind massive forecast change as stock roars 15% on earnings
articles.description: CEO Lisa Su highlighted the growing demand for central processing units, doubling her long term forecast after strong first-quarter earnings.
